claim: For every completed role in the audited inventory, every retained instance field is initialized at successful construction. Traversing any number of retained child edges reaches only immutable scalars, checked reference-free lists, the sealed native release enums, or another role with the same checked guarantee.
argument: Readonly fields and enum singletons fix one node. A detached list retains only the elements admitted by its verified copy operation. Apply those facts along each finite path from the root. Type cycles only identify which checked rule applies along an edge. This argument applies to every constructible finite graph of these roles and uses no database observations as premises.
